raw_text: Kotlin Multiplatform Vulkan 1.4 RAII wrapper; Vulkan 1.3 minimum. Full API/extensions except deprecated/unsupported: render passes/framebuffers, custom allocators, raytracing. Uses exceptions, context `NativePlacement`; caller handles memory. Core over extensions. `Device` factory. Sort functions visibility then lexicographically. Public APIs require KDoc. Run tests and static analysis: `./gradlew check`
